purpose: Pre-freeze calibration phase of experiment E-A (four-arm W x D ablation). Selects the fixed control parameters (W*, alpha*) for the fixed arms using ONLY the 8037 real calibration requests, and runs the C5-dynamic log-signature smokes for the A10/A01/A11 arm configurations on the decoupled controller (ea_v1_code_lock). No evaluation-request access; no performance claims from this phase; smoke data never enters selection.
why_existing_scans_insufficient: All retained fixed-vs-adaptive scans (driver35/38/39, oeplb_fixed_adaptive_results.json, oeplb_adaptive_both_constructions.json) ran on synthetic grid/crossdomain workloads (L512_O1_realprover, crossdomain_freq6_O10, universal_16k) outside the paper's real-request scope, and none swept (sync_window, decay_factor) jointly. Per the user rule this counts as insufficient -> small grid on calibration requests, chosen before evaluation and frozen.

grid.W16_justification: v3-lineage value (sync_window=16) included as candidate so the adaptive arms' starting window is in the fixed candidate set; avoids weak-control strawman per user rule
grid.adaptive_flags: adaptive_window=False, adaptive_decay=False for ALL grid combos (A00-style)
grid.order: 2 rounds; within round W ascending x alpha ascending; deterministic, fixed before execution

expected_signature.note: v3-style signatures (ADW shrink/grow, WINDOW shift, RESET events); exact counts workload-dependent; arg flags both True

fixed_shared_flags: threshold-ratio 1.02; min-prefill-tokens 256; window-floor 8; window-shift-confirm 2; max-total-swap-layers 94; max-swaps-per-layer 64; min-swap-ops 8; max-total-ops 300; dead_zone_ratio default 0.0 -> controller auto-sets 1+0.00408*EP^1.52=1.096 IDENTICALLY in every arm (C6, audit F4: no CLI value disables it; documented, not varied); calibrate_adaptive_sensitivity default False -> warm-start/tier paths unreachable in every arm (C7); model/parallelism/backend/mem-fraction/cuda-graph identical to v3 online launcher.

arm_parameter_mapping_after_selection.A00: sync_window=W*, decay_factor=alpha*, both adaptive flags OFF
arm_parameter_mapping_after_selection.A10: sync_window=16 (adaptive start, v3 lineage), decay_factor=alpha*, adaptive_window ON, adaptive_decay OFF
arm_parameter_mapping_after_selection.A01: sync_window=W*, decay_factor=0.5 (v3 lineage base alpha; modulated by D), adaptive_window OFF, adaptive_decay ON
arm_parameter_mapping_after_selection.A11: sync_window=16, decay_factor=0.5, both adaptive flags ON -> byte-identical launch configuration to v3 online arm (contemporaneous re-run required by user rule because controller code changed)

selection_rule.metric: total_time_s of the full calibration pass (8037 requests, concurrency 256, identical completed workload per start)
selection_rule.validity: bench_rc==0 AND errors==0 AND ok==8037; invalid starts are retained+retired, never retried
selection_rule.combo_score: mean total_time_s over valid starts of the combo; combo with 1 valid start uses n=1 mean (flagged); 0 valid -> ineligible
selection_rule.freeze_point: written to configs/followup_v1/ea_v1_fixed_params.json BEFORE any evaluation or campaign start; never revised afterwards

recording_per_start: campaign_state entry with mechanism line counts (ADW/WINDOW/RESET/WARMSTART/CALIB/REFINE/arg flags/tracebacks)
estimated_runtime: 27 starts x (boot ~8-13 min + calibration pass ~7 min + teardown ~1-2 min) ~ 7.5-9.5 h
